definitions.explanation: A person who moves to live permanently in a foreign country.
The act of moving to a foreign country to live.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{祖父|そふ}はアメリカへの{移民|いみん}だった。
examples.english: His grandfather was an immigrant to America.

examples.japanese: {移民|いみん}{政策|せいさく}について{議論|ぎろん}する。
カナダに{移民|いみん}する。

notes:
{移民|いみん} is composed of {移|い} (move) + {民|みん} (people).

RELATED TERMS:
- {移民|いみん}{政策|せいさく}: immigration policy
- {移民|いみん}ビザ: immigration visa
- {不法|ふほう}{移民|いみん}: illegal immigrant

DISTINCTION:
- {移民|いみん}: immigrant (voluntary relocation)
- {難民|なんみん}: refugee (forced displacement)
